snippet.title: Dicealot Coming October 9th - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
https://www.yogscast.games/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035330/Dicealot/ 

Dicealot is a Farkle inspired roguelike dice-builder where you will gather the finest hands of fantastical dice to hit hard and save the kingdom.
Find power dice combos within your rolls to rack up points! Be beware, for the more you roll, the greater the risk, so you’ll need nerves of steel to keep rolling when you could farkle and lose it all!
